verdict.rationale: GrowthBook documents adding experiment rules to feature flags that hash users into experiment variations (docs-33, docs-29). It analyzes results against goal, secondary and guardrail metrics defined from the warehouse, using Bayesian or Frequentist engines, and highlights a clear winner via 'Chance to Win' above 95% (docs-8, docs-9, docs-7, docs-30, gh-6). Community users confirm running flags and A/B tests in production (comm-4, comm-6). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of multivariate (more than two arm) experiments beyond the plural 'variations' wording.
